{{Top|leg}}
The '''shadowroot plant''' was a rare plant found only on the forest moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. It was used by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] shaman [[Logray/Legends|Logray]] to make [[shadowroot soap]].
